normalization: Valid UTF-8; Laravel Str::ascii, mb_strtolower, non Unicode letters/numbers to spaces, collapse whitespace. Source SHA256 is exact original UTF-8.

formulas.vector_top1: First exact vector cosine, or 0 when missing.
formulas.margin_1_2: max(0, first cosine minus second cosine); missing positions are 0.
formulas.lexical_top1: First positive ts_rank_cd raw score; missing is 0.
formulas.vector_lexical_agreement: Intersection size of vector top3 and positive lexical top3 chunk IDs divided by 3.
formulas.exact_taxonomy_name_match: 1 iff normalized query contains a complete curated taxonomy_category title or alias at whole-token boundaries; otherwise 0.
formulas.normalized_keyword_overlap: Unique useful query tokens intersect union useful search_text tokens of vector top3, divided by unique useful query tokens; empty denominator yields 0.
